# LLM Perfected

> AI-powered front office for Bay Area small businesses: a configured AI receptionist that answers every call 24/7 in English or Spanish, books appointments, follows up on leads, and escalates anything it can't handle to a real person. Also builds related AI agents (sales qualification, scheduling, document drafting, recruiting, reputation management) and offers website design and local SEO.

Headquartered at 140 San Pedro Rd, Daly City, CA 94014. Phone: +1-415-251-6201. Email: sales@llmperfected.com. Serves businesses across the San Francisco Bay Area, including San Francisco, Daly City, Oakland, San Jose, and the greater Peninsula.

Flat monthly pricing: $347/mo (Starter) to $697/mo (Full Front Office), plus a one-time setup fee of $900-$1,800, with custom pricing for multi-location or high-volume teams — not per-minute billing.

## Research and comparisons

- [The Real Cost of a Missed Call](https://www.llmperfected.com/resources/cost-of-a-missed-call.html): Sourced data on missed-call rates and revenue impact for home-services businesses, with a worked Bay Area example.
- [AI Receptionist vs. Human Answering Service](https://www.llmperfected.com/resources/ai-receptionist-vs-answering-service.html): Side-by-side comparison of AI receptionists, self-serve AI apps, and traditional human answering services.
- [Bilingual Answering Service in the Bay Area](https://www.llmperfected.com/resources/bilingual-answering-service-bay-area.html): Census-sourced language data explaining why bilingual (English/Spanish) call handling matters in this region.
